lcc_original: 來管晝夜，分別光暗：上帝看這很好。
notes: 來 left unannotated — Chinese purposive particle with no independent Hebrew equivalent; lamed prefix (09001) attached to 管 as part of the verb unit
UNV 明 (bright) → LCC 光 (light): different Chinese words, same Hebrew referent H0216 (אוֹר)
UNV 神 → LCC 上帝: systematic terminological difference for H0430 (אֱלֹהִים)
UNV implicit {<WAH03588>} (כִּי/that) → LCC has explicit 這 (this/that), so braces dropped per Rule 3
很 left unannotated — Chinese degree adverb with no Hebrew counterpart; H2896 (טוֹב) attached to 好 only
